content.title: About
content.content: Reduced‑sugar chocolate milk is a beverage made from whole cow’s milk, enriched with cocoa butter and natural flavorings. The lower sugar content makes it more suitable for people monitoring glucose levels while preserving the classic chocolate taste.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The reduced sugar is achieved by using stevia and erythritol, which do not raise blood glucose.
Cocoa butter retains beneficial polyphenols known for antioxidant properties.
The product is certified by NFS (National Food Standards), guaranteeing compliance with high food quality standards.
Chocolate milk is often used in sports nutrition as a quick source of carbs and protein after workouts.
Compared with regular chocolate milk, this version has lower calories per serving.

items.title: Rich in calcium
items.content: Milk provides an excellent source of calcium, supporting bone and dental health.

items.title: Contains protein
items.content: Each serving delivers about 8 g of protein, aiding muscle recovery.

items.title: Low glycemic impact
items.content: Reduced sugar and sweet‑eners result in a milder effect on blood sugar levels.

items.title: Antioxidants from cocoa
items.content: Cocoa polyphenols help combat free radicals and support cardiovascular health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Milk supplies vitamin B2 (riboflavin) and vitamin B12, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance should choose lactose‑free versions or alternative drinks.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Allergy to casein or whey can trigger reactions even in small amounts.

items.title: Sweet‑ener side effects
items.content: Erythritol and stevia may cause mild gastrointestinal discomfort when consumed in large quantities.

items.title: Caloric content
items.content: Although sugar is reduced, the drink still contains calories, so portion control is advised.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Reduced‑sugar chocolate milk can be enjoyed chilled as a refreshing drink, added to smoothies, used in desserts, or consumed as a post‑workout recovery beverage.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 1 °C–4 °C. Once opened, consume within 5 days. Do not freeze, as it may alter the texture.
